_README: STUDENTS: Choose 6-8 models from this list. Models starting with _ are candidates — remove the _ to activate them. All run on our Azure endpoint (crete-xamoulis-resource). Ask Stergios to deploy new ones if needed.
_TASK: Research each model: Is it open or closed? How many parameters? Who made it? Why might it be good/bad for Greek? Write your justification in the report.

gpt-5.4-pro.notes: Reasoning model. Slow, no temperature support.

_Mistral-Large.notes: Strong multilingual. Available in Azure AI model catalog.

_Phi-4.notes: Small model. Tests if size matters for Greek judgments.

_Qwen2.5-72B.notes: Strong multilingual open model. Available in Azure AI catalog.

_Llama-3.3-8B.notes: Small Llama. Direct comparison with 70B — does 9x more params help?

_Gemma-2-27B.notes: Medium open model. Available in Azure AI catalog.

_Cohere-Command-R-Plus.notes: Good multilingual. Available in Azure AI catalog.
